regime.label: Cautious, no panic
regime.summary: S&P 500 -1.9% and Nasdaq -2.5% at the close, led by chips after a new US rule on remote access to AI chips and Nvidia's CEO departure. VIX about 24: alert, still below panic (30). Brent about $92.75, 10-year 5.12%.

brief: US stocks closed about 1.9% lower, the third down day, as chips sold off before Nvidia's results on Tuesday. Nothing new to buy tonight: keep the Richemont CHF 170 order, skip the Cisco $96 order (Monday close not confirmed above $94), and add no AI stock before Nvidia.

todo.focus: Nvidia results tonight (~01:20 Dubai). Prepare, don't bet.

items.text: Richemont: if Mon close above CHF 165, BUY 2 CFR, limit CHF 170 (Zurich)
Cisco: if Mon close above $94, BUY up to 6 CSCO, limit $96
Cisco: Mon close not confirmed above $94. Skip the $96 order, no CSCO buy today
Do NOT buy more Nvidia or AI stocks before the results tonight

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: BUY 6 with a limit at $89 (Fri close $88.77). Can be placed now. Then 6 more each week while below $91.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. 3.5% below its high after a -3% month.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: BUY 2 with a limit at CHF 170 for Tue Nov 17 (can be placed tonight). Mon close CHF 173.95. Keep until Fri Nov 27; never pay above CHF 175.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 206.

cards.name: EVENT: Nvidia results Tue (call 02:00 Dubai Wed)
cards.trigger: HOLD. No new AI buy before the numbers. Act Wed after 19:00 Dubai using the playbook.
cards.story: Options price a move of about 9.6%. First report since the CEO resigned; the risk is the reaction, not the numbers.

cards.name: Fortinet
cards.trigger: WAIT. Do not place the $125 order (cancel it if placed). Reconsider after the Q4 report (early Feb 2027) if service growth is back above 15%.
cards.story: Not a mood drop: service revenue grew only about 13% and its guide was cut, while the firewall refresh cycle fades.

cards.name: Cisco
cards.trigger: WAIT. Not triggered: Monday close not confirmed above $94. No $96 order Tue. Recheck after Nvidia results.
cards.story: Sales +24% and forecast raised, but gross margin fell to 65.6%. Part real, part mood.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit may have filled Mon (about $286 at 10:23 ET). If not filled, it stays valid until Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled; 28% below its high. Also benefits from the Anthropic IPO.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: Closed $376.28 Mon, under the $385 floor. From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 at a $395 limit only if TSM closes back above $385 first.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 10 with a limit at EUR 48.50 if IFX holds above EUR 46. Mon close EUR 49.24.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips; 45% below its high. Growth leans on one segment.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 with a limit at $335, only if ETN holds above $327. Fri close $352.97.
cards.story: Sales +28%, guidance raised a third time, yet down 17.6% in a month on data-center fears.

cards.name: Global Payments
cards.trigger: BUY 6 with a limit at $86 (pre-rumor level), valid until Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: -12% when buyout talks ended. Business unchanged, about 6.5x profit.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: BUY 2 with a limit at EUR 235 (Mon close EUR 241.55).
cards.story: Organic growth +17%, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal, not demand.

cards.name: L3Harris
cards.trigger: WATCH only. No buy this week. Reconsider after the FAA names the cause; if L3Harris is cleared and LHX holds above $255, BUY 2 at a $255 limit.
cards.story: Core solid: Q3 revenue +7%, EPS guide raised. But the Communications guide and 2028 cash flow target were cut, and the FAA cause is unresolved.

cards.name: ServiceNow
cards.trigger: WATCH. Reconsider only if NOW closes above $105.12 and holds there through Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: Sales still +20%, but margins fell and estimates are cut. 42% below its high.

cards.name: Dell
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before results Tue Nov 24. Reconsider Fri Nov 27 only if DELL holds above $320 after them.
cards.story: Revenue +58% and outlook raised, but memory shortages threaten margins and analysts are cutting. Mixed, not mood.

cards.name: Corteva
cards.trigger: AVOID. Do not buy the dip. Recheck only after the Q4 report if Brazil sales stop falling.
cards.story: -24% in a day after cutting its yearly forecast. Sales -9%, Latin America -31% on a Brazil farm slump.

agenda.event: Empire State survey 17:30; Fed's Williams 18:05; Fed Chair Warsh 21:00 Dubai
US retail sales 17:30; Home Depot, Disney; Nvidia after close (call 02:00 Wed)
Fed minutes 23:00; Target, Lowe's, TJX; Palo Alto after close
Anthropic (ANT) starts trading, range $70-78; Walmart; Intuit after close
Sandisk first day after its 8-for-1 split
Dell, HP, Analog Devices, Autodesk, Best Buy
